description: This file defines the PHP class Opencart.Admin.Model.Catalog.AttributeGroup, which manages attribute groups within the catalog module of OpenCart. It includes methods for creating, editing, deleting, and retrieving attribute group data and descriptions.

classes.name: AttributeGroup
classes.description: PHP class representing attribute group operations within the catalog module of OpenCart.

methods.name: addAttributeGroup
methods.description: Adds a new attribute group with its descriptions, returning the new attribute group ID.

methods.name: editAttributeGroup
methods.description: Updates an existing attribute group's data and descriptions.

methods.name: deleteAttributeGroup
methods.description: Deletes an attribute group and its descriptions from the database.

methods.name: getAttributeGroup
methods.description: Retrieves data for a specific attribute group by its ID.

methods.name: getAttributeGroups
methods.description: Fetches a list of attribute groups with optional sorting, ordering, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalAttributeGroups
methods.description: Returns the total count of attribute groups.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for an attribute group in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptions
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for a given attribute group.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes descriptions across all attribute groups for a specific language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific attribute group.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions in a specific language for all attribute groups.
